status.en: 5 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% fewer than the week before, most of them in Quito, Calceta and Guayaquil.
status.nb: 5 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Quito, Calceta og Guayaquil.

summary.en: US forces have begun a land operation against cartels inside Ecuador while expanding military activities across Latin America. President Noboa asked the United States for $430.5 billion in security aid, met with Pete Hegseth on anti-narco cooperation, and rejected claims that former vice president Jorge Glas was tortured, saying his injuries were self-inflicted. Journalist Omar Toledo, who denounced local corruption, was shot by motorcycle gunmen. A fugitive Ecuadorian gang boss known as Commander Willy was arrested at a hotel in Sitges and deported from Spain, and a top drug gang leader arrived in Ecuador after deportation from Spain. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.
